text.card: A red giant 3,373 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.02 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,665 K at its surface.
